sloka: उत्पन्नस्त्वं गुणश्रेष्ठो मम रामात्मजः प्रियः ।यतस्त्वया प्रजाश्चेमाः स्वगुणैरनुरञ्जिताः ॥२-३-४०॥
transliteration: utpannastvaṁ guṇaśreṣṭho mama rāmātmajaḥ priyaḥ ।yatastvayā prajāścemāḥ svaguṇairanurañjitāḥ ॥2-3-40॥

translations.english: As you have endeared yourself to these subjects with your virtues, you shall assume the office of heirapparent when Pushya star is in conjunction with the Moon.
